title: Kissed Crunchy Greek Shrimp Skewers
description: A quick and fresh Greek dish featuring shrimp, nuts, and dashi extract, served in an agave leaf vessel, perfect for a light and crunchy snack.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat.
In a bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the shrimp onto skewers, leaving a small space between each shrimp.
Brush the agave leaves with olive oil and place a skewer on each leaf.
Sprinkle the sliced almonds over the shrimp.
Drizzle the dashi extract over the shrimp and almonds.
Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the shrimp are pink and cooked through.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional lemon juice and almonds if desired.
